targets.summary: Only the FromImpl<std::optional<T>> path was updated to use the new heap-allocated StableIValue API; the matching ToImpl optional conversion (around line 614) also needs the TORCH_FEATURE_VERSION >= 2.13 handling.
targets.stage3_reason: FromImpl<std::optional<T>> now allocates through `aoti_torch_new_stable_ivalue`, but ToImpl<std::optional<T>> still frees with a raw `delete sivp`. That mismatches the allocator across the ABI boundary. The merged code adds `TORCH_ERROR_CODE_CHECK(torch_delete_stable_ivalue(sivp));` under `#if TORCH_FEATURE_VERSION >= TORCH_VERSION_2_13_0`, which is exactly the requested fix.
